question: Does wind-conditioned recurrence of individual-level vertical flight-use distribution occur beyond colony-attached gulls in a migratory soaring bird (Ciconia ciconia)?

archive.study: Fall migrations of juvenile vs. adult white storks (data from Rotics et al. 2016)
archive.filename: Fall migrations of juvenile vs. adult white storks (data from Rotics et al. 2016)-gps.csv.zip
archive.reference_filename: Fall migrations of juvenile vs. adult white storks (data from Rotics et al. 2016)-reference-data.csv
archive.license: CC0 public domain dedication; research citations required
archive.stage: Autumn migration, adults and juveniles. No biological altitude outcomes opened in this prospective extension.

constraints.biological_species: One independent order Ciconiiformes, NOT the same species, site, or movement strategy as gulls
constraints.use_x_y_coordinate_system: EPSG:6933 WGS84 EASE-Grid 2.0 global cylindrical equal-area
constraints.reference_training_rules: same bird other UTC days >=10 fixes in matched cell AND other conspecific different UTC dates >=10 in same cell
constraints.secondary_scales: 50 and 100km are only prospective description of whether a migrating taxon supports shared horizontal cells. They cannot replace a failing 5km primary as if pre-confirmatory equivalent.
constraints.session_statistics: Count independent animals and bird-days, not serial GPS events.
constraints.measurement: Native height-above-ellipsoid if present; do not open until source and structural support are frozen; terrain and geoid differences must be audited before any ecological shape interpretation.
constraints.age: Use published reference-data animal-life-stage with exact same animal IDs; do not guess stage if missing.
constraints.no_data_overlap: Archive may overlap other MPI white stork datasets on Movebank. Treat as one dataset/parent, never multiple independent replications.

distinct_ecology: This is a nomadic migration corridor, not central-place breeding flight. If 5km same-cell repeat is unavailable, conclude transport of the gull fixed-site estimand fails structurally, not that migratory birds lack individuality. Candidate alternative estimand must be stated separately before opening any 2014 altitude outcomes.
result_guard: Do not auto-run altitude significance on this source. Preflight records stage-specific counts, data schema, sampling regime and day-level horizontal overlap only.
